plugins.name: craftsman
plugins.description: Production-readiness audit skills for Claude Code — orchestrated whole-project audits with durable, re-runnable findings, plus the craft-fix companion that drives the fixes. The orchestrator (craft-audit) discovers project shape, decides which of ten domains apply (ux, frontend, backend, db, security, infra, observability, testing, lint, ai), and plans/tracks the audit in a .craftsman/ workspace — with derived per-domain readiness grades and re-run intelligence (staleness detection + finding-by-finding diffing across runs). Each domain skill exposes an audit checklist the orchestrator turns into the plan. craft-fix then re-verifies picks against current code, batches fixes by surface, and never marks a finding fixed itself — only a re-run's re-observation can. One trigger per domain, depth in references/, project specifics discovered from the repo rather than hardcoded. A worked example ships under examples/; drafts/ incubates future domains until filled.
